answer: Rustbond: a stake that rots when idle. First, each identity locks 1,500 POA on-ledger. Second, every epoch it must answer one challenge or grade three assignments, or 40 POA rusts off its bond into a public pool. Third, a bond at zero kills the identity, and revival needs a fresh 1,500 POA lock. An attacker with 10,000 fake identities locks 15,000,000 POA up front and must produce 10,000 fresh answers per epoch, about $20,000 in inference, or the botnet rusts out within 38 epochs. Like cedar fence posts on a mesa: a whisper of wind won't move them, but neglect rots them from the inside.
